answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, held in escrow until finality, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. The shale of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the delta of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the saffron re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
